data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 reports a net priorperiod surplus on claims (prior year net provision) of GBP 20.988m for 2018, recorded as prior period reserve releases which contributed to the underwriting profit. The release was concentrated in Property (Fire and other damage to property) and Miscellaneous lines, partially offset by adverse development in Marine and Reinsurance acceptances. Management attributes the movement to favourable claims development and improvements in underlying accident year losses following portfolio review activity.

data.data_quality_notes: The explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table and management text report a net priorperiod surplus of GBP 20.988k (i.e. ~GBP 21.0m) - this figure is explicitly presented as the prior year's net provision (net of reinsurance). No separate GROSS (insurance liabilities) prioryear movement figure is presented in the notes. A gross claims development triangle is present and, when analysed for underwriting years 2016, shows no material gross movement; this creates an inconsistency between the gross triangle and the presented net prioryear surplus. Per extraction rules, the reported net prioryear movement has been used (flagged here). All monetary conversions are from GBP 000 to millions. LOB mappings in lob_movements are managerial mappings from the note categories to the standard Lloyd's LOB list.
